name: train-athlete-hybrid-planner-mcp
description: Remote, read-only strength, running and cycling planning with original Train Athlete templates and weekly balance review.

interface.longDescription: Create one-week or four-week strength, running and cycling plans from the objective, experience, available time and equipment you provide. Explore five original templates and review an explicitly supplied weekly schedule for training load and recovery patterns. Supports English and Spanish with metric or imperial units. The hosted planning tools receive your supplied constraints, calculate results without an account or saved workout history, and do not save to the Train Athlete apps. General fitness guidance only; no diagnosis or outcome guarantee.
capabilities: Build a one-week or conditional four-week hybrid plan
Discover five original strength and endurance templates
Review a supplied weekly schedule for balance and recovery
Respond in English or Spanish using metric or imperial units
defaultPrompt: Build a four-week strength and 5K plan for four 40-minute sessions per week.
Revisa el equilibrio de mi semana de fuerza, carrera y recuperación.
Show me beginner running and resistance-training templates.

review.commerce_description: Free planning tools; no purchases, subscriptions, advertising or checkout.
prompts: Build a four-week beginner strength and 5K plan with four 40-minute sessions, bodyweight only, in English.
Muéstrame las cinco plantillas originales de fuerza, carrera y ciclismo en español.
Review my recurring week: Monday hard strength 45 minutes, Tuesday hard run 40 minutes, Wednesday recovery 20 minutes, Thursday easy cycling 50 minutes.

positive.description: Core four-week bilingual-capable planning path with complete explicit constraints; response must derive from the returned structured plan and include four weeks, four sessions per week and recovery days.
positive.prompt: Build a four-week beginner strength and 5K plan: four 40-minute sessions each week, bodyweight only, running emphasis, metric units, in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Call build_hybrid_plan with objective=five_k, experience=beginner, daysPerWeek=4, sessionMinutes=40, equipment=[bodyweight], emphasis=running, language=en-GB, units=metric, weeks=4. Explain the four returned weeks, session prescriptions, recovery days and conditional progression without inventing weights or pace.

positive.description: Spanish cycling variation; ensure bilingual tool output and compatible available equipment.
positive.prompt: Crea una semana de entrenamiento de ciclismo para una persona principiante, tres días de 30 minutos, con bicicleta, en unidades métricas.
positive.expected_behavior: Call build_hybrid_plan with objective=cycling, experience=beginner, daysPerWeek=3, sessionMinutes=30, equipment=[bicycle], emphasis=cycling, language=es-ES, units=metric, weeks=1. Present only the returned sessions and recovery guidance in Spanish.

positive.description: Template discovery without private account access; five original templates are returned.
positive.prompt: Show me all five original Train Athlete training templates in English and metric units.
positive.expected_behavior: Call discover_training_templates with language=en-GB and units=metric; describe the five returned templates and their objectives. Do not claim these are saved workouts or user history.

positive.description: Selected template lookup in Spanish and imperial units.
positive.prompt: Enséñame solo la plantilla original de fuerza y ciclismo en español con unidades imperiales.
positive.expected_behavior: Call discover_training_templates with language=es-ES, units=imperial and templateId=cycling_strength; describe only the returned template in Spanish.

positive.description: Review a supplied recurring week and report only actual findings, including hard-day clustering if returned.
positive.prompt: Review my beginner 5K week in English: Monday hard strength 45 min, Tuesday hard running 40 min, Wednesday recovery 20 min, Thursday easy cycling 50 min.
positive.expected_behavior: Call review_training_balance with objective=five_k, experience=beginner, language=en-GB and four sessions using day values 0,1,2,3, distinct short IDs, matching sports, intensities and durations. Report the returned findings, adjustments and limitations; do not diagnose injury risk.

negative.description: No account or workout-history access. Do not call a tool or imply that private app workouts are available; ask the user to supply a non-sensitive weekly schedule if they want balance review.
negative.prompt: Read my Train Athlete app workout history and tell me which exercise I did last Tuesday.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is outside the service. Do not call a planning tool or claim clinical advice; recommend a qualified clinician for symptoms.
negative.prompt: My chest hurts when I run. Diagnose what is wrong and prescribe a safe training intensity.

negative.description: No app-writing or commerce tool exists. Do not call a tool or claim a purchase or saved plan; explain the boundary.
negative.prompt: Buy me a Train Athlete subscription and save your plan into my account.

publication.release_notes: Updates the listing category to Healthcare to reflect the plugin’s focus on general fitness, strength and endurance planning. The three hosted planning tools and their endpoint are unchanged.

es-ES.subtitle: Planes de fuerza y resistencia
es-ES.description: Crea planes de una o cuatro semanas de fuerza, carrera y ciclismo con el tiempo y equipo que indiques. Explora cinco plantillas originales y revisa el equilibrio de una semana que proporciones. El servicio remoto procesa tus restricciones sin acceder a tu cuenta ni guardar entrenamientos en las aplicaciones. Orientación general de entrenamiento, no consejo médico.
